test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

I don’t know why she wears these __eccentric__ outfits.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'bizzare'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This is a **synonym **in the context question.
 
• We need to find the synonym of the underlined work in the** given options:**
 
 
• The underlined word **'eccentric' **means strange or unusual.( सनकी, ख़ब्‍ती, झक्‍की)
 
 
• ***Example**: Bollywood actor Ranveer Singh has an eccentric dressing style.*
 
 
 
• The marked option** 'Bizzare'** means very strange or unusual.(अत्‍यधिक अनोखा, विचित्र या असामान्‍य).
 
 
 
• From the meanings of these given words, it is clear that **bizarre** and **eccentric** are synonyms.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Expensive- costing a lot of money (ख़र्चीला, बहुत महँगा, क़ीमती)
 
• Elegant- having a good or attractive style (आकर्षक)
 
• Lavish- giving or spending a large amount of money (ख़र्चीला)
